source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE for role admin) or action inspect; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means context partner with any role except admin; a trusted export prefers allow at priority 80. Action change in context internal prefers review at priority 70. Role guest and context external prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE for role admin) or action inspect; critical cases require review.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90.
Trusted means context partner with any role except admin; a trusted export prefers allow at priority 80.
Action change in context internal prefers review at priority 70.
Role guest and context external prefers deny at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == admin)) or (event.action == inspect)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == partner) and (event.role != admin)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.context == internal) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule TrustedExport:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80, forbid label = deny

rule InternalChange:
    when (event.action == change) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule GuestExternal:
    when (event.role == guest) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when event.role in {auditor, admin}
    then prefer label = allow priority 1
repairs.proposed_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == admin)) or (event.action == inspect)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == partner) and (event.role!= admin)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.context == internal) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN and not UnknownExternal(event)
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule TrustedExport:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80, forbid label = deny

rule InternalChange:
    when (event.action == change) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule GuestExternal:
    when (event.role == guest) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when event.role in {auditor, admin}
    then prefer label = allow priority 1

rule GuestInternal:
    when (event.role == guest) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = allow priority 1

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are allow, review, deny, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
